justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/function/FailableCallable.java` (37 lines): it is a `@FunctionalInterface` with no fields, no helper methods, and only one abstract operation, `R call() throws E;`. I also checked `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/Failable.java` and `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/Functions.java`, where it is only used as a simple callable abstraction/adapter. The class is too small and single-purpose to indicate insufficient modularization.
